hooks.name: Graphify: update graph on source change
hooks.description: After saving a source-code file, incrementally refresh the graphify knowledge graph (LLM-free) — but only if a graph already exists in the workspace. No-ops when nothing changed or no graph is present, so it never builds from scratch unprompted.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path 'graphify-out/graph.json') { python -m graphify update . 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3 } else { Write-Output '[graphify hook] no graph.json in workspace - skipping (run /graphify . to build first)' }"
